Howon · Listen & Shadow 04

Someone Else's Work
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · SOMEONE ELSE'S WORK
👤 Brian
What was so similar?
뭐가 그렇게 비슷했어요?
similar — 비슷한
💬 Howon
There was too much resemblance.
닮은 점이 너무 많았어요.
resemblance — 닮음, 유사성
같은 패턴으로 — There's a strong resemblance between the two scenes. · I see a resemblance to his earlier work.
💬 Howon
He copied my acting.
그 사람이 제 연기를 베꼈어요.
copy — 베끼다 · plagiarize — 표절하다
같은 패턴으로 — She copied my lines word for word. · They plagiarized the whole script.
💬 Howon
He just took it.
그냥 가져다 쓴 거예요.
take it — 가져다 쓰다
💬 Howon
He was mimicking me.
제 흉내를 내고 있었어요.
mimic — 흉내 내다 (mimicking — 흉내 내는 중)
같은 패턴으로 — He was mimicking my voice. · Stop mimicking me.
💬 Howon
It's someone else's, not his.
그건 다른 사람의 것이지, 자기 것이 아니에요.
someone else's — 다른 사람의 것
같은 패턴으로 — That idea was someone else's. · I'm wearing someone else's jacket.
💬 Howon
They're not recognizing it.
사람들은 그걸 알아채지 못하고 있어요.
recognize — 알아보다, 인정하다
같은 패턴으로 — Nobody recognized it at first. · They didn't recognize my work.
💬 Howon
It's a total rip-off. It's false advertising.
완전히 바가지예요. 과장 광고예요.
rip-off — 바가지, 베낀 것 · false advertising — 과장 광고
같은 패턴으로 — That price is a rip-off. · The poster was false advertising.
💬 Howon
It's ridiculous.
말도 안 돼요.
ridiculous — 말도 안 되는
같은 패턴으로 — That's a ridiculous idea. · The price is ridiculous.
💬 Howon
That was an insult to me.
그건 저한테 모욕이었어요.
insult — 모욕
같은 패턴으로 — Don't insult him. · It's an insult to the audience.
PART 2 · HOW I FELT
👤 Brian
How did you feel at the time?
그때 기분이 어땠어요?
at the time — 그때
💬 Howon
It felt empty — kind of pointless.
허무했어요.
empty · hollow · pointless — 허무한
같은 패턴으로 — The win felt hollow. · It all felt pointless.
💬 Howon
I felt drained and deflated.
허탈했어요. 힘이 쫙 빠졌어요.
drained — 기운이 빠진 · deflated — 맥이 풀린 · let down — 실망한 · stunned — 어안이 벙벙한
같은 패턴으로 — I was stunned when I heard it. · I felt let down by my team.
💬 Howon
I was all over the place.
정신이 하나도 없었어요.
all over the place — 정신없는 · swamped · hectic · overwhelmed · out of it
같은 패턴으로 — This week has been hectic. · I'm swamped with work.
💬 Howon
I got defensive.
제가 방어적이었어요.
get defensive — 방어적으로 굴다 (= I was on the defensive)
같은 패턴으로 — Don't get defensive. · I was on the defensive the whole time.
💬 Howon
I didn't want to make it awkward.
분위기를 어색하게 만들고 싶지 않았어요.
make it awkward — 어색하게 만들다
같은 패턴으로 — Don't make it awkward. · He made it awkward by staying.
💬 Howon
There was a misunderstanding.
오해가 있었어요.
misunderstanding — 오해
같은 패턴으로 — It was just a misunderstanding. · Let's clear up the misunderstanding.
💬 Howon
I can sense that.
그렇다는 게 느껴져요.
sense — 느끼다, 감지하다
같은 패턴으로 — I can sense he's nervous. · She sensed something was wrong.
PART 3 · HER
👤 Brian
What kind of person is she?
그 사람은 어떤 사람이에요?
kind of person — 어떤 사람
💬 Howon
She's a complex, complicated character.
복잡한 캐릭터예요.
complex / complicated — 복잡한 · character — 인물
같은 패턴으로 — He's a complicated guy. · It's a complex role to play.
💬 Howon
She's a bit sly — kind of cunning.
좀 약아요.
sly · cunning · foxy — 약은, 교활한
같은 패턴으로 — He's a sly negotiator. · That was a cunning move.
💬 Howon
She has low self-esteem.
자존감이 낮아요.
self-esteem — 자존감
같은 패턴으로 — Low self-esteem can make people defensive. · Her self-esteem went up after the show.
💬 Howon
She goes along with it when she knows the person likes her.
상대가 자기를 좋아하는 걸 알면 그냥 따라가요.
go along with — 따라가다, 맞춰주다
같은 패턴으로 — I just went along with the plan. · He goes along with whatever his boss says.
💬 Howon
But she goes the extra mile when she knows someone doesn't like her.
그런데 누가 자기를 싫어하는 걸 알면 오히려 더 애써요.
go the extra mile — 한 걸음 더 애쓰다
같은 패턴으로 — He always goes the extra mile for clients. · She went the extra mile to win them over.
💬 Howon
She confessed to me that she had recorded the show with my acting.
제 연기가 나온 방송을 녹화했다고 저한테 털어놨어요.
confess — 고백하다, 털어놓다 · record — 녹화하다
같은 패턴으로 — He confessed that he'd lied. · She confessed to me that she was scared.
💬 Howon
That's one of the barriers to getting back with my ex.
그게 제가 전 여자친구와 다시 만나지 못하는 이유 중 하나예요.
barrier — 장벽 · get back with — 다시 사귀다 (one of the barriers — 복수형)
같은 패턴으로 — Money is one of the barriers to starting a business. · Language is one of the barriers for me.
💬 Howon
I asked it as a favor.
부탁으로 물어봤어요.
ask as a favor — 부탁으로 묻다 · favor — 부탁, 호의
같은 패턴으로 — Can I ask you a favor? · I did it as a favor to him.
PART 4 · EVERYDAY WORDS
👤 Brian
Who did you watch it with?
그 영화 누구랑 봤어요?
watch with — ~와 함께 보다
💬 Howon
I couldn't remember who I watched it with.
누구랑 봤는지 기억이 안 나요.
remember who — 누구였는지 기억하다
같은 패턴으로 — I can't remember where I parked. · I don't remember who told me.
💬 Howon
I got fooled.
완전히 속았어요.
get fooled — 속다
같은 패턴으로 — Don't get fooled by the trailer. · We all got fooled.
💬 Howon
He's clueless.
그 사람은 전혀 몰라요.
clueless — 아무것도 모르는
같은 패턴으로 — I was clueless on my first day. · He's clueless about money.
💬 Howon
The fans rallied behind him.
팬들이 결집했어요.
rally — 결집하다, 힘을 모으다
같은 패턴으로 — The team rallied in the second half. · People rallied to support her.
💬 Howon
That's sexual harassment.
그건 성희롱이에요.
sexual harassment — 성희롱
💬 Howon
He had bipolar disorder.
그는 조울증이 있었어요.
bipolar disorder — 조울증 (= manic depression)
💬 Howon
I have an anterior pelvic tilt.
저는 골반 전방경사가 있어요.
anterior pelvic tilt — 골반 전방경사
